Hi Katie —

Following up from last week's partner office hours: BluePeak is queueing their AWS Marketplace listing and asked if Redwood can be part of the co-sell bundle. We ran an internal pre-check and identified a few compliance/certification items that could block a co-sell readiness sign-off from AWS.

Quick context: BluePeak is building a managed Redwood Dedicated offering they plan to list under their consulting partner profile (related account: BluePeak Systems). Their engineering lead Ravi is on this thread. Goal is to get the listing certified for co-sell within a 4-week window if possible.

Can you confirm the following from the AWS side so we can map owners?
- Which AWS verification docs are strictly required for co-sell for a partner-managed software listing vs a professional services listing?
- Any mandatory security evidence beyond standard marketplace docs (e.g., SOC 2 attestations from us/BluePeak, encryption KMS mapping)?
- Typical timeline and gating items for the co-sell enablement checklist you use internally (is there a 3rd-party review step)?

I'm attaching our gap matrix (work-in-progress) — if you can annotate which rows are "fatal blocker" vs "can be remediated post-listing" that'd be hugely helpful.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Tessa to own outreach and timeline
- Vanessa to lead GTM/co-sell materials and playbook alignment
- Marcus to own technical evidence and cert consolidation
- Soojin to run legal/contracting flag review

Would you have 30 minutes next week to go over the matrix and agree a sprint plan? Prefer Tues/Wed mornings PST.

Thanks — appreciate your help.

Best,

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the context and the matrix. I pulled the Marketplace co-sell checklist into a single PDF for you (attached) and annotated the high-risk items below. Short answers:

1) Required docs: for a partner listing where the partner is the primary seller (BluePeak) you'll need a vendor profile, a listing artifact, and a technical validation that the product meets AWS security baseline. Redwood's SOC 2 can be referenced in the listing but we typically expect the partner (BluePeak) to surface their SOC if they're the primary software operator.

2) Additional mandatory evidence: encrypted data-at-rest with customer-managed KMS is often required for co-sell across regulated workloads (finance/health). If the partner offers a managed service on behalf of customers, we need an operations runbook (obligatory) and an incident escalation path documented.

3) Timeline: typical fast-track is 3–6 weeks if evidence is ready. There is a separate internal co-sell enablement review (evaluations team) that runs a technical validation — usually a 5–7 business day window once you submit the packet.

I've marked the rows in the checklist as: RED = needs action before co-sell, AMBER = can be submitted but will require post-listing remediation, GREEN = fine. See aws-co-sell-checklist.pdf (attached).

I can do Tue Dec 1 10:30–11:00 PST or Wed Dec 2 09:00–09:30 PST. Book whichever works and include the BluePeak folks.

Cheers,
Katie Holland
Senior Partner Specialist, AWS Marketplace
attachments: aws-co-sell-checklist.pdf (annotated)
